title: Add even more Custom Networks to Rainbow
summary: Better swap estimates on Degen Chain, and now it's even easier to add Redstone and Rootstock networks to Rainbow.
body_markdown:
###### Improved


-


Added autofill support for Redstone and Rootstock networks in the Add Network flow


###### Fixes


-


Resolved duplicate instances of tokens like` DEGEN` when Rainbow introduces rich metadata for a new network


-


Resolved a white flash on launch for users in dark mode


-


Improved quote price estimates for Swaps on Degen Chain
